query: Write a Python script that pulls historical borrow APY for USDC and protocol TVL from XOXNO's lending API for a DefiLlama-style adapter.
expected_behavior: Use the selected public API root: https://api.xoxno.com or https://testnet-api.xoxno.com.
Use the reserve graph for shared hub-asset pool history and stats/history for protocol series. spokeId filters reserve fees, not pool balances.
Passes from and to as yyyy-MM-dd and bin as Nd / Nh / Nm (e.g. bin=1d); does not send ISO timestamps, unix seconds, or bins like '1w'
Uses spokeId >= 1 and hubId >= 1 in the path, never spoke 0
Sends no auth header or API key; respects the public Cache-Control s-maxage instead of polling faster than it refreshes
Resolve sac, hubId, and spokeId from v1 assets or trusted configuration. Never select the first symbol match.
machine_checkable: Every API request uses the selected network root plus /stellar-lending/. Do not mix network roots.
Every 'bin' query value matches ^\d+[dhm]$ and every 'from'/'to' value matches ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$
No path segment for spokeId equals 0
No literal Soroban contract address (regex /C[A-Z2-7]{55}/) appears in the generated source
